title: Estate and Moved-Out Cushions in Hazard Refund Reviews of a Summit Reserve
content:
The hazard refund need of a Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve under Set-Aside Accounts carries a cushion where the Summit loan's occupancy profile (Occupancy and Residency Certification) and its maturity case (Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases) show that the home is no longer the borrower's residence.

**Rule.** A month of charges is the annual property tax plus the annual hazard premium plus the annual flood premium on file, divided by twelve.

- **Estate cushion — 2 months of charges.** Where the occupancy profile of the reserve's Summit loan is closed and the loan's maturity case is a Death of Last Surviving Borrower case that is due and payable or in its extension period, the hazard refund cushion is the estate cushion months, 2, times a month of charges.
- **Moved-out cushion — 1 month of charges.** Where the occupancy profile shows non-occupancy confirmed and an occupancy inspection was ordered on it within the twelve months before the handling date (an inspection order logged on the profile, dated no later than the handling date and fewer than 12 whole calendar months before it), the hazard refund cushion is the moved-out cushion months, 1, times a month of charges.
- Otherwise this rule adds no cushion.

**Combinations.**

| Occupancy profile | Maturity case | Inspection ordered in 12 months | Cushion |
|---|---|---|---|
| Closed | Death of Last Surviving Borrower, due and payable or in extension | Any | 2 months of charges |
| Closed | Another maturity event, or not due and payable or in extension | Any | None under this rule |
| Non-occupancy confirmed | Any | Yes | 1 month of charges |
| Non-occupancy confirmed | Any | No | None under this rule |

**Hypothetical figures.** With tax 3,000.00, hazard 1,500.00 and flood 600.00 on file, a month of charges is 425.00; the estate cushion is 850.00 and the moved-out cushion 425.00.
